outcome: composite adverse maternal outcomes (death or severe maternal complications)
composite adverse neonatal outcomes (perinatal death or severe neonatal complications)
cohort: 835 women with a history of a primary low transverse cesarean delivery and subsequent singleton term delivery with vertex presentation
finding: Among women with a history of a primary low transverse cesarean delivery, those who underwent TOLAC had increased odds of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes when VBAC likelihood was less than 60%, but similar or decreased odds when VBAC likelihood was 60-100%.
mod_finding: Women with a history of cesarean delivery and a VBAC likelihood of less than 60% had increased odds of adverse outcomes with trial of labor compared to elective cesarean.
